name: Southwire
verdict: Southwire Company, LLC has been owned by the Richards family since 1950. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of Envision Racing since June 2024. US family-owned wire and cable maker; no state or state-fund owner, and no human-rights finding of the kind METHOD.md counts was located (its labour-court history is 1980s NLRB collective-bargaining litigation, which does not count).
